Would it be fair if I provide this list of papers as reference , on the repo there are no axioms added nor any 'sorry' included, i guess using an ITP is fringe on physics and math but Im totally on your side guys using lean would be a standard practice on the near future.

some of the main references are:
DOI: 10.1093/ptep/ptad025 - Automatic hermiticity for mixed states - Keiichi Nagao and Holger Bech Nielsen

Entropy as a Clock: Foundations and Parametrizations of Emergent Time

The concept of entropy. Relation between action and entropy, Jean Pierre Badiali

What I can suggest now is that you make a PR which includes references - and we can go from there (this will at least make it easier to see what you are suggesting adding).

This PR series adds an entropic proper-time formalism for open quantum systems, using tools from quantum information and nonequilibrium dynamics, it includes formalized definitions, eq., and bridge lemmas motivated by work on Nagao-Nielsen complex action, Caticha’s Entropic Dynamics, Lindblad dynamics, classical thermodynamics, path integrals, contour methods, Chern-Simons theory, Wilson-loop structures

To be clear, this does not replace any existing physics in Physlib. It is an additive layer intended to make it possible to track a time parameter associated with entropy and information flow in none-quilibrium open quantum systems, while keeping the usual geometric and dynamical notions available
